description: S1. Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker and Zealous Conscripts untapped on winota_lua's turn (pod OuY6mdiXbHU). The loop: Kiki copies Conscripts (its only legal copy target here), the hasty copy's enter trigger untaps Kiki, repeat for any number of hasty 3/3s, then attack. Tests the trigger target on every pass (in games the copy untapped Kiki 0 of 8 times; it took Rionya, Mirage Phalanx, Winota or an opponent's permanent). Success: winota_lua wins on the scenario turn.
notes: Kiki's only legal copy target is Conscripts (Winota is legendary and stays in the command zone), so every activation reaches the Conscripts trigger, the choice under test. A probe with Mirage Phalanx beside them showed stock Forge copying Phalanx instead, which tests a different choice.

Three lands and this turn's land drop already used, so Winota (4 mana) cannot be cast: her attack trigger adds combat damage on its own and would blur whether the loop ran. The loop itself needs no mana.
Opponents hold no instant-speed interaction, so the scenario measures the pilot, not a counterspell.
Every seat at 40 life: without the loop the board deals under 10 damage, far short of a kill.
